title: Descent of morphisms between perfect complexes
statement: Let R be a filtered colimit of rings R_i, let X_i be a finitely presented R_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme], and put X=X_i \times_{\operatorname{Spec} R_i} \operatorname{Spec} R. Let P_i and Q_i be perfect objects of D(O_{X_i}) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] and write P,Q for their pullbacks to X. Every morphism f:P \to Q in D(O_X) is, after replacing i by a later index j, the pullback of a morphism f_j:P_j \to Q_j; moreover, if f is an isomorphism then j may be chosen so that f_j is an isomorphism, and finitely many prescribed equalities between such morphisms hold at the same later index.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.29.2, Tag 09RE, label lemma-descend-homomorphisms (full faithfulness), used in Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF
